descripcion: Native Android AI agent: 抱朴 is a first-party, in-process harness that reads and writes your files, handles images and pages, plans and writes. 玄览 is the browser it sees through. The terminal is a separate app (zhengdao-term). No root, no Termux, no ADB. 安卓原生 AI agent：内置抱朴＋玄览浏览器；终端独立为 zhengdao-term。Android 16 (API 36) + arm64.
